children: Six-Decade-Old Florida and Georgia Brokerage Makes Bond’s AI-Powered Preventative Personal Security Standard for Every Agent, Companywide
Bond Estimates U.S. Real Estate Market Opportunity at Over $300 Million Annually
Companywide Rollout Launches During REALTOR® Safety Month to Support the Safety of Real Estate Professionals
NEW YORK and JACKSONVILLE, Fla., Sept. 11, 2026
-- Our Bond, Inc. (“Bond”)

, the creator of the world’s first AI-powered Preventative Personal Security platform adopted by leading multinational companies, today announced that it has teamed up with Watson Realty Corp. (“Watson”), one of the largest and longest-established independent residential real estate brokerages in the Southeast, to provide Bond’s personal security services to approximately 800 real estate agents across Florida and Georgia. The companywide rollout launches this month to coincide with REALTOR® Safety Month, the National Association of REALTORS®’ (“NAR”) annual September initiative dedicated to the safety of real estate professionals.

Founded in 1965 and headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida, Watson has grown over six decades into a network of approximately 40 offices serving Northeast and Central Florida and Southeast Georgia, complemented by affiliated mortgage and title operations. Under the agreement, Bond becomes a standard resource for every Watson agent – provided by the company, not purchased individually – making Watson among the first brokerages of its size in the United States to extend professional, 24/7 personal security to its entire agent population.

Real estate is one of many professions in which working alone with strangers is an inherent part of the job. Agents routinely meet unfamiliar individuals for the first time, show vacant properties, host open houses and travel to unfamiliar locations, often outside business hours. According to NAR’s 2024 Member Safety Report, more than one in five REALTORS® (22%) have experienced a situation that made them fear for their personal safety. Bond is designed for exactly the moments that fall between “everything is fine” and “call 911”: with a single tap, an agent can have a live Bond Personal Security Agent monitor a showing or open house in real time, track their trip to and from a property, check in if they fail to arrive as expected, help de-escalate a situation, and coordinate with first responders if it becomes an emergency.

“Our agents are the heart of this company. They spend much of their working lives away from an office, meeting people for the first time and walking into properties alone, and we believe they should have professional security resources available to them wherever their work takes them,” said William Watson III, President of Watson Realty Corp. “Bond has created a new reality. For the first time, our agents don’t have to wait until it’s an emergency to get help, and Bond agents can even deter threats before they ever become emergencies. I felt an obligation to do this for my people.”

“We’re proud to now be able to identify Watson as our partner in this previously-announced deal. Revolutions require new technologies and operating models, but also leaders who can look ahead and see what is coming next. Watson has been a leader in Southeastern real estate for more than sixty years, and Bill’s decision to make Bond standard for every agent, companywide, says a great deal about how seriously he takes the people who carry his name into the field every day,” said Doron Kempel, Founder and CEO of Bond. “The workplace no longer ends at the office door, and neither should an employer’s commitment to its people. Real estate is a clear example of a large, distributed workforce that is an opportunity for Bond to enhance peace of mind for millions of people, and we believe Watson’s leadership sets a standard that brokerages across the country will follow.”

Watson is the leading Southeastern real estate company referenced in Bond’s August 20, 2026 announcement of its entry into the U.S. real estate market. With more than 1.4 million REALTORS® represented by NAR, Bond continues to estimate the real estate market opportunity for its platform at over $300 million annually in the United States and over $1.5 billion globally. The Watson deployment also illustrates the operating leverage of Bond’s enterprise distribution model, in which a single organizational relationship adds hundreds of covered individuals and recurring subscriptions at once, and which Bond believes can be replicated efficiently across other large, distributed workforces that operate outside a traditional office.
About Watson Realty Corp.

Founded in 1965 by William A. Watson, Jr., Watson Realty Corp. is one of the largest independent, family-led residential real estate brokerages in the Southeast, serving communities throughout Northeast and Central Florida and Southeast Georgia through approximately 40 offices and affiliated mortgage and title services. For more than six decades, Watson has maintained a longstanding focus on service, professionalism and support for its agents and customers. Additional information is available at www.watsonrealtycorp.com.
About Bond

Bond is an international company headquartered in New York City — with command centers around the world — that is redefining personal security through its AI-powered Preventative Personal Security platform. The company has invested more than $100 million to date in its technology, operations, and global expansion.

Bond offers personal security to more people than any other company globally. Bond is trusted by leading corporations, cities, and universities, and has already supported more than 1.25 million security service requests, including over 10,000 emergencies and life-saving interventions. Bond operates in 28 countries and growing, positioning itself as a new global standard for personal security and peace of mind. Additional information about the Company is available at: www.ourbond.com.
